papers.title: CistromeMeta: A Large Language Model Powered Tool for Automated ChIP-seq Metadata Extraction
papers.summary: Abstract Summary Public repositories such as NCBI’s Gene Expression Omnibus (GEO) contain large numbers of ChIP-seq experiments, but their reuse is limited by heterogeneous free-text metadata describing target proteins, histone marks, cell lines, tissues, and disease states. We introduce CistromeMeta, a Python-based command-line tool that leverages large language models (LLMs) in a few-shot setting to automatically extract and standardize ChIP-seq metadata from GEO XML records without custom model training. The tool validates extracted terms against authoritative biological databases, including NCBI Gene, Harmonizome 3.0, AnimalTFDB 4.0, Cellosaurus, Experimental Factor Ontology, and Uberon, producing standardized outputs with official gene symbols and ontology identifiers for scalable metadata curation. Availability and Implementation The Python source code is freely available at https://github.com/nickpiccaro/CistromeMetaX . An archived version of the software is available through Zenodo at The tool requires Python 3.6+ and an OpenAI API key
papers.llm_title_zh: CistromeMeta：一种基于大型语言模型的自动化工具，用于提取ChIP-seq实验的元数据。
papers.llm_title_bilingual: CistromeMeta：一种基于大型语言模型的自动化工具，用于提取ChIP-seq实验的元数据。 / CistromeMeta: A Large Language Model Powered Tool for Automated ChIP-seq Metadata Extraction
papers.llm_research_question_zh: 摘要：像NCBI的Gene Expression Omnibus（GEO）这样的公共数据库中存储了大量ChIP-seq实验数据，但由于用于描述目标蛋白、组蛋白修饰、细胞系、组织类型及疾病状态的元数据种类繁多且格式不一，这些数据的重复利用受到了很大限制。
llm_highlights_zh: 我们推出了CistromeMeta这一基于Python的命令行工具。该工具利用大型语言模型，在无需进行任何自定义模型训练的情况下，能够自动从GEO XML记录中提取并标准化ChIP-seq元数据。
该工具会将提取出的术语与权威的生物数据库进行比对，这些数据库包括 NCBI Gene、Harmonizome 3.0、AnimalTFDB 4.0、Cellosaurus、Experimental Factor Ontology 以及 Uberon。通过这一过程，系统能够生成包含官方基因符号及本体标识符的标准化输出结果，从而便于进行大规模的元数据整理与管理工作。
可获取性与实现方式：Python源代码可免费在以下链接获取：https://github.com/nickpiccaro/CistromeMetaX。
